task_description: Módulo 3 (data layer): integrate Supabase as BaaS for the fitness web module apps/macros-web. Design a relational schema (profiles 1:1 with auth.users, macro_goals with goal_type enum deficit/mantenimiento/volumen + tdee + calorie_target + protein_g/fat_g/carbs_g, weight_logs, food_logs) using UUID PKs (gen_random_uuid()), created_at/updated_at timestamptz with a reusable set_updated_at() trigger, FKs to auth.users ON DELETE CASCADE, and helpful indexes, leaving room for future daily logs/measurements. Enable RLS on all four tables with explicit per-command SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies restricting rows to auth.uid() (INSERT WITH CHECK, UPDATE USING+WITH CHECK). Add a Supabase client initialized ONLY from VITE_ env vars (clear error if missing), hand-written strict DB types (no any), pure async data-access functions for macro goals with PostgrestError mapped to clear non-leaky Errors, and TanStack Query setup (QueryClientProvider) with useMacroGoal() (read) + useSaveMacroGoal() (upsert, invalidates on success) exposing loading/error/pending states, NO useEffect for fetching. Tests: data-access unit tests (mocked client, success + error-mapping) and hook tests (query/mutation states) via a QueryClient wrapper. Min 80% coverage. SQL/RLS statically validated and documented for the Supabase SQL editor (no live DB in sandbox).

verification.summary: Final verification from apps/macros-web with the Module-1 energy domain temporarily materialized from main (NOT committed; restored --staged + rm -rf before/after so it never entered any commit). typecheck PASS (tsc --noEmit strict, no any), lint PASS (ESLint no-console clean), build PASS (vite built 131 modules), Vitest 119/119 tests across 20 files pass. Coverage: global 98.66% lines / 90% branches / 96.55% funcs (above 80% thresholds). New data-layer files at 100% stmts/branch/funcs: src/features/macro-goals (macroGoals.data.ts, queryKeys.ts, types.ts, useMacroGoal.ts, useSaveMacroGoal.ts), src/lib (env.ts, supabaseClient.ts), src/app (queryClient.ts/QueryProvider.tsx). Test quality verified: macroGoals.data.test.ts drives the real success/null/error-mapping paths with a mocked Supabase query-builder chain, asserts the thrown Error message does NOT contain the raw Postgrest detail/hint/message (non-leak), and asserts the save input is never mutated and is_active is forced true; hook tests use renderHook under a fresh retry:false QueryClientProvider with the data module mocked, asserting loading->success, isError on rejection, mutation isPending transition, and that a successful mutation invalidates the active query key (invalidateQueries spy). SQL static sanity: 4x ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, 16 CREATE POLICY, 8 WITH CHECK (4 INSERT + 4 UPDATE), 4 ON DELETE CASCADE matching 4 auth.users FKs. No live Supabase DB in sandbox so the migration/RLS was NOT executed against a real DB; it is shipped statically validated and documented for the Supabase SQL editor. No Dockerfile (docker build not applicable). Expo root app untouched.
